symlink.what_the_lane_does: Directory digest scopes fail closed. File symlink arguments are canonicalized with readlink -m and judged as the referent, then the SAFE/NOT-SAFE line is printed on the raw symlink path. A dangling symlink becomes NOT-SAFE(unreachable) missing path after canonicalization, which hides the link. Plain mv of a symlink moves the link; mv of readlink -m moves the target and dangles the link.
symlink.label_split: souji-vault-verify.sh emits NOT-VERIFIED(symlink-present). souji-verify.sh leaves receipt=none and puts obsidian=symlink-present in evidence. Do not claim both tools use the same receipt token.

quarantine.what_the_lane_does: Quarantine is a hold inside <repo>/.ufo-quarantine/<utc-date>/, then a second receipt check, then delete (SKILL.md:38-41). Both verifiers exclude **/.ufo-quarantine/** from live-reference sweeps, so a basename that appears only there can be SAFE(stale) refs=0. That exclusion is not a preservation receipt and not permission to delete the quarantined bytes. Staging must move the directory entry, not the referent of a symlink.

additional_not_folded_into_the_required_: Driver runtime (scripts/, .ufo/state/, .ufo/watchdog.log) is in SKILL.md:49-50 and PROVINCE refuses, absent from the frontmatter anti-trigger. 'operator config' does not name them. A 'clean'/'prune' request for the watchdog log is not anti-triggered.
NOT host/package/systemd cleanup (tsukuroi). PROVINCE adjacency: souji removes files and never touches the OS. 'clean' can steal that work.
NOT process or daemon kills (mori observes; souji does not act on processes).

NEVER git fetch/push is absent from the live frontmatter. tools and spec refuse fetch. Body line 16 still prescribes git fetch. skill-amend-21.diff already proposes the fetch/push clause and still omits symlink and quarantine-hold. Not re-authored here.

recommended_anti_trigger_clause: NEVER follow a symlink to remove or quarantine its target: mv of the link moves the link; mv of readlink -m moves the target and dangles the link. A symlink path is not a duplicate and not a receipt — both verifiers canonicalize with readlink -m before judging, then print the raw path, so a SAFE line on a symlink argument can be the referent's receipt. A directory digest that contains any symlink is refused (souji-vault-verify.sh: NOT-VERIFIED(symlink-present); souji-verify.sh: receipt none, evidence obsidian=symlink-present), not SAFE(moved-to-obsidian). A dangling symlink reported unreachable/missing-path is not already gone. NEVER treat quarantine as deletion: stage the directory entry into <repo>/.ufo-quarantine/<utc-date>/, never the referent; hold at least 450s (prefer 24h unless the receipt is pushed); second receipt check before any delete from quarantine. A basename that appears only under .ufo-quarantine/ is excluded from both tools' live-reference sweeps and can yield SAFE(stale) refs=0 — that exclusion is not a preservation receipt and not permission to delete the quarantined bytes. Live or unpushed lane work stays NOT-SAFE to delete.
